source: CENSUS: two independent census.gov primaries fetched direct 2026-09-06. notes: DISCOVERED by the construction-spending-2026-11-02 adjacency sweep as the demand-side read of the same September 2026 reference month. Initial research 2026-09-06 confirms the release identity and then finds the thing that separates this edition from every other in the family: 2026-10-27 is FOMC-eve. The October 2026 FOMC meets October 27-28 (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, 56 decision days parsed 2021-2027), so this print lands at 10:00 on day one of the meeting, inside the blackout that began 2026-10-17, with the decision the next morning. Measured on Yahoo daily bars, that configuration is TWO stacked nulls: the release-day null replicates across eight instruments on 65 sessions since 2021 (SPY p=0.5957, QQQ p=0.8604, ITB p=0.2979, XHB p=0.3110, DHI p=0.5637, LEN p=0.8847, PHM p=0.8313, TOL p=0.2249, homebuilder ETFs narrower), and FOMC-eve is itself a null on 45 pairs (SPY 0.924% vs 0.976% p=0.6681, ITB 1.851 vs 2.012 p=0.3068, XHB p=0.4538, TOL p=0.7063) while the DECISION day is dramatically louder (ITB 3.154% vs 2.012% p<0.0001, XHB p<0.0001, TOL p<0.0001, SPY p=0.0009). ITB's eve range is below its decision-day range in 36 of 45 pairs (80.0%), median ratio 1.68x. Only 3 of 77 New Residential Sales release sessions since 2020 have touched an FOMC decision or its eve at all, so this is a rare configuration and the corridor's housing risk sits on 10-28, not on this print. On the nowcast: the 2026-10-27 PostedUpdates row names just two items — the M3-1 trigger and this print — the cleanest bundle in the 2026 set, and M3-1 without new-home sales moves the residential contribution a median 0.0005pp (n=34, only 3 of 34 clearing 0.02pp), so any residential move on 10-27 is attributable to this print. Impact LOW, symbols empty: no house playbook is macro-keyed (0 hits, re-grepped 2026-09-06) and no instrument attaches. Ledger: docs/research/events/new-home-sales-2026-10-27.md
